armyRules.name: Last Stand of the Broken Fleets
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit with this rule at half strength or fewer fights on with a survivor's fury: each model gains +1 Attack. A unit with this rule can never choose to Fall Back.
armyRules.condition: while at half strength or fewer

armyRules.name: Mixed Banners
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A Character with this rule is the glue of the survivors. Friendly units within 6" add +1 to their Cool. If the Character is removed, every friendly unit within 12" must pass a Cool Check or gain the Pinned Status.

armyRules.name: Held Together by Spite
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A Dreadnought with this rule gains Feel No Pain (6+), but cannot Rush.

wargear.name: Wall of Names banner
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tattered banner stitched with the names of everyone who didn't make it off the world. Every model in the unit gains +1 Willpower and +1 Intelligence.

wargear.name: Patched refractor field
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A refractor belt salvaged from a dead officer and repaired with whatever was to hand. The model's Invulnerable Save becomes 5+ if it was worse.

wargear.name: Field-welded plating
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Hull plates from three different wrecks, welded onto an Ancient who refuses to stay dead. The model gains +1 Wound.

wargear.name: Ashes reliquary
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A sealed urn of soil from a homeworld that no longer exists. Gives the bearer Ashes Remembered.

wargear.name: Cracked void-plate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Armour that once sealed a ship's airlock and has outlasted three owners. Gives the bearer Scar-Hardened.

wargear.name: Tithe crate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. The last of the squad's ammunition, handed round before the final push. Gives the unit Tithe of Shells.

wargear.name: Rally beacon
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hand-cranked lamp whose pattern every survivor of the old fleets still knows. Gives the bearer Rally Flare.

wargear.name: Slab-plates
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Slabs cut from fallen hulls and bolted over every joint. Gives the model Slab-Plated.

wargear.name: Orphaned machine-spirit
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cogitator core that has lost its crew and learned to watch for itself. Gives the model Vigil Spirit.

rules.name: Muster Call
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Broken Banners Reforged). A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Cool for Cool Checks while another friendly Inductii unit is within 12".

rules.name: Survivor's Oath
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Oath of the Survivors). A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Cool for Cool Checks while it is within 12" of a friendly Garviel Loken, Saul Tarvitz, Shadrak Meduson, Alexis Polux or Hibou Khan.

rules.name: Dig In
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Fortress of the Last Stand). A unit with this rule has Shrouded (6+) against shooting attacks while it has not moved in its own most recent Movement phase.

rules.name: Ancient Resolve
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Ancients Awake). A unit with this rule is immune to Fear and automatically passes Cool Checks. It must be deployed on the table and may not be held in Reserve.

rules.name: Ashes Remembered
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Friendly Shattered Legions units within 6" of the bearer add +1 to their Cool for Cool Checks. Once per battle the bearer's unit may pass a Cool Check automatically.

rules.name: Scar-Hardened
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The first Wound the bearer would lose each battle is ignored.

rules.name: Tithe of Shells
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, in the Shooting phase, a unit with this rule adds 1 to the Firepower of each of its ranged weapons for one Shooting Attack.

rules.name: Rally Flare
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the start of a friendly turn, the bearer's unit and one other friendly unit within 12" each remove one Tactical Status.

rules.name: Slab-Plated
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Unsaved Wounds from weapons with AP 4 or worse inflict 1 less Damage on this model, to a minimum of 1.

rules.name: Vigil Spirit
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, when an enemy unit ends a move within 12", this model may make a Shooting Attack against it at -1 Ballistic Skill.

Survivor's relics: may take one item

The Sergeant may carry a Rally beacon
One Legionary may carry a Salvaged rocket tube

The Sergeant may take a Survivor's war-pick

modifiers.text: Cornered men fight hard: +1 WS, -1 LD.
Hard-won veterans of the broken fleets: +1 A, -1 CL.
Held together by prayer and spite: +1 BS, -1 M.
Wall of Names banner: +1 WP, +1 IN.

rites.name: Broken Banners Reforged
rites.flavor: Seven Legions' worth of orphans, one muster call.
benefits: Inductii Squads of any Legion gain Line (2).
Inductii gain Muster Call: +1 Cool for Cool Checks while another friendly Inductii unit is within 12".
limitations: At least two Inductii Squads are required.
No Armour or Lord of War units.

require.note: Field at least two Inductii Squads.

modifiers.text: Broken Banners Reforged: Muster Call, Line (2).

rites.name: Oath of the Survivors
rites.flavor: Whoever else is dead, somebody has to carry the story out.
benefits: Every Legion Infantry unit gains +1 Willpower and Hatred (Traitors).
Those units gain Survivor's Oath: +1 Cool for Cool Checks while within 12" of the army's named survivor.
limitations: Garviel Loken, Saul Tarvitz, Shadrak Meduson, Alexis Polux or Hibou Khan must be in the army.
No Lord of War units and at most one Armour unit.

require.note: A named survivor must lead the oath.

modifiers.text: Oath of the Survivors: Hatred (Traitors), Survivor's Oath.

rites.name: Fortress of the Last Stand
rites.flavor: If you cannot leave, you had better dig in.
benefits: Heavy Support Squads, Tactical Support Squads and Rapier Batteries may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those units gain Dig In: Shrouded (6+) while they have not moved this turn.
limitations: At least one Rapier Battery is required.
No Fast Attack or Recon units.
No unit may use Outflank, Infiltrate or Deep Strike.

require.note: Bring at least one Rapier Battery.

modifiers.text: Fortress of the Last Stand: Dig In, Line (1).

rites.name: The Ancients Awake
rites.flavor: When the Legions died, their oldest warriors stayed in their coffins and kept fighting.
benefits: Contemptor, Castra Ferrum, Deredeo and Leviathan Dreadnoughts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those Dreadnoughts gain Ancient Resolve: they are immune to Fear and automatically pass Cool Checks.
limitations: At least two War Engine units are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler or Assault Squads.
Dreadnoughts with Ancient Resolve may not be held in Reserve.

modifiers.text: The Ancients Awake: Ancient Resolve, Line (1).
